title: Peruvian Anticuchos
description: A traditional Peruvian dish, these anticuchos are grilled beef heart skewers that are tender, flavorful, and full of warm, smoky goodness.
instructions: Cut the beef heart into 1-inch pieces.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, red pepper flakes, black pepper, and salt.
Add the beef heart pieces to the marinade and mix until they are well coated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread 4-6 pieces of the marinated beef heart onto each skewer.
Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
Grill the anticuchos for 5-7 minutes per side, or until they are cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Serve the anticuchos hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
